gist.headline: Right-to-left, ready to fly
gist.blurb: Aaarraaa has landed in the image garden: an Arabic-first, browser-only way to walk through Pollinations BYOP login. No backend nest required.
gist.summary: Added aaarraaa, a static Arabic RTL web app that implements Pollinations.ai’s BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow entirely in the client browser.
gist.impact: Arabic-speaking builders can now explore and use the BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE flow through a right-to-left interface without deploying a backend server.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy Arabic RTL login journey as a garden path of glowing browser windows and key-shaped flowers. Polli, wearing a tiny explorer scarf, guides a friendly user-facing terminal through a lime-green OAuth gate, with right-to-left pixel text and code-plants showing that the flow runs in the browser rather than a server room.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light-blue wings, and a tiny explorer scarf, guiding a glowing retro browser through a garden gate shaped like a key; the screen shows simple Arabic RTL pixel text and a client-side PKCE code-plant, while no server towers appear. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with flowers and vines around the browser.
